setup_instructions.overview: Setup requirements and instructions for using the Bobathon Builder mode, particularly for the opportunity tracking feature.

requirement.name: personal_access_token
requirement.description: IBM GitHub Enterprise Personal Access Token (PAT)

setup_steps.step: Give it a descriptive name (e.g., "Bobathon Builder Tracking")
Select the "repo" scope (required for creating issues)
Set expiration as needed (recommend 90 days or no expiration)
Copy the token immediately (it won't be shown again)

requirement.name: environment_variable
requirement.description: GHE_TOKEN environment variable set with your PAT

temporary.note: Valid only for current PowerShell session

permanent.note: Requires restarting terminal/VSCode to take effect
permanent.alternative: Set via System Properties → Environment Variables

temporary.note: Valid only for current shell session

requirement.name: network_access
requirement.note: May require VPN or corporate network connection
requirement.verification: Test with: curl https://github.ibm.com/api/v3/user -H "Authorization: token YOUR_TOKEN"

opportunity_tracking_setup.description: The Bobathon Builder automatically tracks all bobathons by submitting opportunity numbers to a central GitHub repository. This enables reconciliation and reporting.

how_it_works.step: User provides Salesforce opportunity number (18 characters)
Mode detects operating system (Windows vs macOS/Linux)
Mode executes platform-specific command to create GitHub issue
Issue is tagged with appropriate labels: - "opportunity-tracking" (always applied) - "education-testing" (automatically added if opportunity is 000000000000000000)
Mode confirms successful submission and proceeds with bobathon setup

issue_format.title: Opportunity: [18-character-number]
issue_format.labels: - opportunity-tracking (always) - education-testing (only if opportunity number is 000000000000000000)

reconciliation.description: All submitted opportunities can be viewed and reconciled using GitHub issue filters

filter.name: real_opportunities_only
filter.description: View only real client opportunities (excludes education/testing)

filter.name: education_testing_only
filter.description: View only education and testing bobathons

export_options.option: Query via GitHub API for programmatic access
Use GitHub CLI: gh issue list --label opportunity-tracking
Filter real opportunities: gh issue list --label opportunity-tracking --label "!education-testing"

issue.name: missing_token
issue.solution: Set the GHE_TOKEN environment variable with your IBM GitHub Enterprise PAT. See setup instructions above for your platform.
issue.verification: Check if token is set: - Windows: echo $env:GHE_TOKEN - macOS/Linux: echo $GHE_TOKEN

issue.name: invalid_token
issue.solution: Token may be expired or invalid. Generate a new token with 'repo' scope.
issue.verification: Test token: curl -H "Authorization: token YOUR_TOKEN" https://github.ibm.com/api/v3/user

issue.name: permission_denied
issue.solution: Token doesn't have 'repo' scope. Regenerate token with correct permissions.

issue.name: network_error
issue.solution: - Verify VPN connection if required - Check corporate network access - Test connectivity: ping github.ibm.com

issue.name: invalid_opportunity_format
issue.symptom: Validation error about opportunity number format
issue.solution: Opportunity number must be: - Exactly 18 characters - Only letters (A-Z, a-z) and numbers (0-9) - No spaces, dashes, or special characters - Example: 000Xx00000XXxXXXX0

issue.name: command_not_found
issue.symptom: PowerShell or curl command not found
issue.solution: - Windows: Ensure PowerShell is available (should be default) - macOS/Linux: Ensure curl is installed (usually default) - Try running command manually to verify

testing_setup.description: Test your setup before running a real bobathon workflow

test_steps.step: Verify GHE_TOKEN is set: - Windows: echo $env:GHE_TOKEN - macOS/Linux: echo $GHE_TOKEN
Test API access: curl -H "Authorization: token YOUR_TOKEN" https://github.ibm.com/api/v3/user
Try creating a test issue manually using the commands in 4_tool_usage.xml

security_notes.note: Never commit your GHE_TOKEN to version control
Use minimum required permissions (repo scope only)
Revoke tokens when no longer needed

support.description: If you encounter issues with opportunity tracking setup
